# QORPO

> QORPO is an independent game studio from Slovakia that builds in public. It is the studio behind AneeMate (creature collecting adventure, free on Epic Games Store during Early Access), One Life (AI-native shooter built on Citizen Conflict technology), Citizen Conflict (third-person shooter, Unreal Engine 5) and Tamitos (children's IP: animated series, books, games, the TAMITOS Move app). One token, $QORPO, sits behind every game the studio ships. Every commit the studio makes is published on https://qorpo.world/live and in https://qorpo.world/feed.json, updated hourly from GitHub.

## Key facts
- Studio: QORPO s.r.o., Slovakia. Building since 2020, zero hacks, 124,000+ commits across 280 repositories (snapshot 6 October 2026), more than 1,000 commits in the last 30 days from 7 builders.
- Token: $QORPO (ticker QORPO), a LayerZero omnichain token (OFT) on Ethereum and BNB Chain, same contract on both: 0x22514ffb0d7232a56f0c24090e7b68f179faa940
- Exchanges: KuCoin, Gate, MEXC (QORPO/USDT). Market data: CoinGecko (id qopro), CoinMarketCap (qorpo).
- Value model: game revenue is used to buy $QORPO back from the open market; part is burned, part funds the next games.
- Utility: staking for daily Community Points by QORPO Power level plus APY tiers up to 30%, free daily spin for stakers, Community Points leaderboard, eligibility for the $TAMITOS airdrop.
- Founder and author of the site's articles: Rastislav Bakala, CEO (https://x.com/RastislavBakala).
- GTA 6 note: QORPO has no affiliation with Rockstar or GTA 6. GTA 6 has no crypto; the related article is about player-owned game economies.

## Products
- AneeMate: creature collecting adventure for PC. Catch, raise and become creatures on a living island. Free on Epic during Early Access. https://aneemate.com/
- One Life: AI-native shooter built in public on Citizen Conflict tech. https://x.com/playOLLgame
- Citizen Conflict: third-person shooter, Unreal Engine 5, built before the AI era. https://citizenconflict.com/
- Tamitos: children's IP about emotions and neurodiversity; animated series, books, games, TAMITOS Move app. https://tamitos.com/
- TAIX: AI streaming extension for Twitch. https://taix.ai/
